purpose: Weapon three-gate Gate C: the 20-case mathematical fidelity matrix, each case anchored to the exact test that proves it. PROVEN = executed real-production assertion on the stated chain; PARTIAL = proven except for the named gap.

cases.title: One-handed ordinary melee, L5 STR+3
cases.rule: Core Rulebook, Combat Statistics > Damage: weapon dice + half heroic level + Strength
cases.field: canonical profile damage dice; actor level/STR
cases.expected: 2d8 + 5 (Vibrosword)

cases.title: Same actor wielding a non-light melee weapon two-handed
cases.rule: Core Rulebook, Combat Statistics > Damage: double the Strength bonus two-handed (non-light)
cases.field: wieldedHands carried from the owned grip

cases.title: Two-handed light weapon
cases.rule: Core Rulebook, Combat Statistics > Damage: no doubled Strength with a light weapon
cases.expected: 2d4 + 5 for one- and two-handed

cases.title: L5 ordinary ranged 3d6 blaster
cases.rule: Core Rulebook, Combat Statistics > Damage: ranged damage = dice + half level (no ability)

tests.needle: ordinary ranged weapons (pistol, rifle) never add Strength

cases.title: Thrown melee
cases.rule: Core Rulebook, Combat Statistics > Damage: melee and thrown weapons add Strength to damage
cases.expected: half level 2 + STR 3 on the thrown profile; attack ability DEX

cases.title: Bow / Sling
cases.rule: Published bow / sling Strength damage, once
cases.expected: half level 2 + STR 3 = 5, once

tests.needle: Strength damage for bow / sling applies once

cases.title: Negative Strength, two-handed non-light
cases.rule: Core Rulebook, Combat Statistics > Damage: only a positive Strength bonus doubles
cases.expected: a penalty is applied once, not doubled

cases.title: Chosen alternative attack mode
cases.rule: Selected profile governs dice / type / range / proficiency
cases.expected: 3d4 / 3d6 / 3d8 + 2 for Variable Blaster low / medium / high

cases.title: +1 weapon and Weapon Specialization
cases.rule: Enhancement and Weapon Specialization add to damage once each
cases.expected: half level 2 + flat +1 + specialization +2 = 5 on a 3d6 pistol; a typed Effect Intent competence bonus resolves highestOnly (not both); Modification V2's certified effects (Durasteel Bonding critical die after the multiplier, Enhanced Energy Projector natural-1 reroll) execute through the real damage and reroll authorities. Modification V2 has no generic +N enhancement: its certified effects are specific.

tests.needle: FIXED: competence damage bonuses from two different source paths

cases.title: Weapon multiplier and critical multiplier
cases.rule: Weapon damage x multiplier; extra weapon damage before it; a critical doubles the result
cases.expected: (10 + 2) x 2 = 24, critical 48

tests.needle: x2 weapon on a critical applies both multipliers

cases.title: Stun / ion / alternate damage type
cases.rule: The selected form's damage type travels to the packet; target-specific consequences follow
cases.field: damageTypes / damageMode on the selected profile
cases.expected: type retained through the packet; stun: a character takes half in HP with the full amount compared to the threshold, a Droid is immune; ion: Droid and vehicle/device take half HP with full-amount threshold and condition-track effects, an ordinary organic is singed with no other effect, a cybernetic creature takes full damage

cases.title: Area miss, Evasion, cover
cases.rule: Area attack: a hit deals full damage, a miss half; no blanket minimum-1 floor
cases.expected: area miss = half (certified policy), never floored to 1; an area HIT of a weapon still takes the minimum-1; Evasion negates a missed area attack and Improved Evasion halves an area hit, through the REAL canonical attack workflow (this pass fixed a defect: the canonical path never marked the attack Evasion-eligible); single-target attacks ignore Evasion

tests.needle: area attack miss keeps its certified half-damage policy
M-12 area miss with a weapon present
Evasion (${name}): a MISSED area attack deals no damage
Improved Evasion (${name}): a hit deals half

cases.gap: Cover negation of area damage (WPN-M12-001): a real attack's workflow does not carry cover state to the damage stage, so the published area-attack cover damage negation cannot trigger. Which cover degrees qualify is a rules question, left undecided. Pinned by a known-gap test.

cases.title: NPC statblock flat attack / damage
cases.rule: The printed statblock total replaces BAB / ability; situational penalties still apply
cases.expected: published totals preserved, range penalty still applied

tests.needle: NPC flat total keeps situational range penalty exactly as before

cases.title: Stock droid imported attack / damage
cases.rule: The published stock-droid formula composes with on-roll rules without duplicating BAB
cases.expected: published formula honoured, no double counting

cases.title: Installed vehicle gunner and weapon
cases.rule: Vehicle weapon damage uses the certified installation and vehicle formula; no personal half level or Strength
cases.field: vehicle weapon authority / sealed installation provenance
cases.expected: vehicle formula (weapon dice x multiplier), certified installation, no personal half level or Strength; the same cannon uses the character range table against a character target and the starship table against a vehicle; an ion/laser hit applies through to HP, threshold and condition track

tests.needle: personal half-level must never apply to vehicle weapon damage
an untouched installed weapon resolves to its certified identity and damage
SCALE: the same cannon uses the CHARACTER table

cases.title: Selected critical damage rider
cases.rule: A rider stays a separate typed component and takes the critical multiplier once
cases.expected: rider rolled separately, critical applied once

cases.title: 1d4-5 on a confirmed weapon hit
cases.rule: Core Rulebook, Combat Statistics > Damage: a successful hit deals at least 1 damage
cases.expected: effective 1 before mitigation; Damage Reduction 5 then takes HP loss to 0; raw total disclosed

tests.needle: M-17 low result on a confirmed weapon hit

cases.title: Equipment / grip / readiness changes after the dialog opens
cases.rule: Revalidate before any spend; refuse; respect rollback
cases.expected: refused before the next expenditure or roll

tests.needle: R4: equipment changed during a dialog / hook / payment boundary is caught

cases.title: Custom / legacy weapon with no canonical identity
cases.rule: Uncertified legacy weapons stay behind the readiness gate
cases.expected: refused, nothing spent

tests.needle: an uncertified legacy weapon is refused by the gate and spends nothing

cases.title: Malformed canonical identity / no-damage form
cases.rule: A broken canonical identity never falls back to the Item dice (no silent 1d6)
cases.expected: refusal (throws), no fallback
